contextual_findings.message: Recipe screenshot checkpoints are captured with capture-helper snapshot (real macOS window) via recipe-capture-helper.json / recipe-baseline-capture-helper.json. These replace the earlier ui.screenshot images, which used the runner extension-dom-raster fallback (CDP Page.captureScreenshot timed out) and rendered overlapping/doubled text.
Video could not be recorded: capture-helper/ffmpeg cannot capture in this SSH environment (Screen Recording TCC for the launcher). Still-image real-window captures are the primary visual evidence.

dual recipe (baseline asserts buggy values, verify asserts fixed values) for honest before-evidence
